functions.name: Shopping cart and checkout on a page
functions.description: A content page runs the Shopping Cart app: cart content, addresses, shipping and payment selection, receipt and confirmation email.

notApplicable.when: checkout runs in a headless frontend through the Delivery API
the demo shows the catalogue with no cart or checkout

functions.name: Completed orders from checkout
functions.description: Checkout converts a cart into a completed order that appears in the Orders list with an order state. A demo that sells proves it with at least one completed order.

notApplicable.when: the demo shows the catalogue with no cart or checkout

functions.name: Back-office order processing
functions.description: Orders, Incomplete orders and Carts lists: change flow and state, capture, refund, cancel, delete, edit order lines, shipping documents, receipt and Excel export. Capture and refund depend on the payment provider.

notApplicable.when: fulfilment and capture are shown in the ERP, not in the back office

functions.name: Order flows and states
functions.description: Order flows with states (received, picked, shipped, completed) that orders move through, one default state for new orders.

functions.name: Order state notification emails
functions.description: An order state sends an email (to billing, shipping, an order field address or named others) when an order enters it, for example a shipped mail with a tracking link.

functions.name: Cart flows
functions.description: Cart flows with states that carts move through before checkout, for B2B or CPQ carts passed between customer and business.

notApplicable.when: carts go straight to checkout with no approval or preparation step

functions.name: Multiple named carts
functions.description: Customers keep several named carts (cart management commands or order contexts) and choose which to check out.

notApplicable.when: buyers work with one cart at a time

sources.ref: DW10 database schema (INFORMATION_SCHEMA of a local DW10 install) and Dynamicweb.Ecommerce 10.29.8

functions.name: Order contexts
functions.description: Separate carts on one website (for example a daily and a weekly cart) selected by an OrderContext parameter, optionally limited to a shop. Largely replaced by named carts.

notApplicable.when: buyers work with one cart at a time

functions.name: Quotes
functions.description: Customers submit a cart as a quote; staff move it through a quote flow and the customer accepts (converts to an order) or rejects it in the Customer Experience Center.

notApplicable.when: the demo story has no request for quote

functions.name: Subscriptions (recurring orders)
functions.description: A base order generates orders at an interval (weekly, monthly) between a start and end date; customers and staff can cancel future deliveries.

notApplicable.when: the demo has no repeat or replenishment story

functions.name: Returns (RMA)
functions.description: Return, defective and exchange cases raised from an order or by the customer, moved through RMA states, closed, optionally ending in a replacement or refund order.

notApplicable.when: returns are handled in the ERP

functions.name: RMA email notifications
functions.description: Emails sent when an RMA enters a state or an RMA event occurs.

notApplicable.when: The catalogue the build reproduces shows no use of this function in its source documentation; the ruling's evidence names the source pages or census items reviewed.

functions.name: Ledger entries
functions.description: Invoices, credit memos and payments, usually imported from the ERP, moved through ledger flows and shown to customers in the Customer Experience Center.

notApplicable.when: the demo shows no invoices or other ERP financial documents

functions.name: Customer self-service (Customer Experience Center)
functions.description: Logged-in customers see orders, quotes, carts, ledgers and subscriptions, reorder a previous order, accept a quote and, with impersonation, see their customers' orders.

notApplicable.when: the demo has no logged-in customers

functions.name: Favourite lists
functions.description: Customers or staff keep favourite lists per user or user group, with quantities, notes and units, for reorder from the storefront.

notApplicable.when: The catalogue the build reproduces shows no use of this function in its source documentation; the ruling's evidence names the source pages or census items reviewed.

functions.name: Custom order fields
functions.description: Custom fields on orders (for example a PO reference, a coupon field or a service checkbox) entered at checkout or by staff.

notApplicable.when: The catalogue the build reproduces shows no use of this function in its source documentation; the ruling's evidence names the source pages or census items reviewed.

functions.name: Custom order line fields
functions.description: Custom fields on order lines, for example a cut length for products sold by the metre.

notApplicable.when: The catalogue the build reproduces shows no use of this function in its source documentation; the ruling's evidence names the source pages or census items reviewed.

functions.name: Checkout field validation groups
functions.description: Validation groups with rules (required, contains, regex, valid email, valid gift card or voucher) selected on the Shopping Cart app to block a checkout step.

functions.name: Payment methods
functions.description: Active payment methods offered at checkout, limited by country and user group, with a manual (invoice) or provider-backed handler.

notApplicable.when: the demo shows the catalogue with no cart or checkout

functions.name: Payment provider integration
functions.description: A payment method uses a checkout handler (for example Stripe, QuickPay, Klarna) that takes card data on the provider's page and reports capture and refund support.

notApplicable.when: the demo takes payment on account or invoice only
The catalogue the build reproduces shows no use of this function in its source documentation; the ruling's evidence names the source pages or census items reviewed.

functions.name: Payment fees
functions.description: Fixed or percentage payment fees from an order total threshold, optionally per country or region.

notApplicable.when: The catalogue the build reproduces shows no use of this function in its source documentation; the ruling's evidence names the source pages or census items reviewed.

functions.name: Saved payment cards
functions.description: Customers save cards with a supporting provider, manage them in the Customer Experience Center and receive expiry reminders from a scheduled task.

notApplicable.when: the demo takes payment on account or invoice only
The catalogue the build reproduces shows no use of this function in its source documentation; the ruling's evidence names the source pages or census items reviewed.

functions.name: Shipping methods
functions.description: Active shipping methods offered at checkout, limited by delivery country, user group, product or group (inclusive or exclusive) and weight.

notApplicable.when: the demo shows the catalogue with no cart or checkout

functions.name: Shipping fee rules
functions.description: Fee rules per shipping method by weight, volume, total, user, group, shop, product, context, country, region, currency or zip, with highest or lowest fee priority.

functions.name: Free shipping threshold
functions.description: No shipping fee above an order amount, optionally on the price with VAT or after discount; methods marked eligible for free shipping discounts.

notApplicable.when: The catalogue the build reproduces shows no use of this function in its source documentation; the ruling's evidence names the source pages or census items reviewed.

functions.name: Shipping provider integration
functions.description: A shipping method uses a carrier provider app (for example GLS, UPS, PostNord, Shipmondo) for fees, service points or shipping documents.

notApplicable.when: shipping fees come from fee rules with no carrier integration

functions.name: Payment and shipping per country
functions.description: Payment and shipping methods restricted to delivery countries and regions.

functions.name: Track and trace
functions.description: Tracking URL schemes with parameters filled per order and used in order state emails.

notApplicable.when: The catalogue the build reproduces shows no use of this function in its source documentation; the ruling's evidence names the source pages or census items reviewed.

functions.name: Country VAT
functions.description: VAT rate per country, applied on the billing (or optionally delivery) country; VAT groups override it and system VAT is the fallback.

notApplicable.when: the market uses sales tax through a tax provider instead of VAT

functions.name: VAT groups
functions.description: Differentiated VAT (reduced, exempt) per country through VAT groups assigned to products.

notApplicable.when: every product carries the country VAT rate

functions.name: Reverse charge VAT
functions.description: Reverse charge for VAT on B2B cross-border sales, set per country, per VAT group country rate or per user.

notApplicable.when: the demo sells within one VAT country

sources.ref: DW10 database schema (INFORMATION_SCHEMA of a local DW10 install) and Dynamicweb.Ecommerce 10.29.8

functions.name: Sales tax providers
functions.description: Tax settings with a provider (flat rate, Avalara AvaTax, Vertex) per country for sales tax and fees on orders.

notApplicable.when: the market uses VAT only
The catalogue the build reproduces shows no use of this function in its source documentation; the ruling's evidence names the source pages or census items reviewed.

functions.name: Address validation
functions.description: Address validators per country validate checkout and user addresses, mainly for US tax. The manual states no validation provider ships for DW10; Vertex validates addresses inside its tax provider.

notApplicable.when: no address validation provider is installed (the 10.29.8 default)

functions.name: Shopping cart behaviour settings
functions.description: Global cart settings: recalculate on login, auto-select single methods, skip zero payment, anonymous cart merge on login, cart isolation, reorder recalculation, cart lifetime and session timeout, saved for later.

functions.name: Order numbering
functions.description: Auto-numbering series for orders, carts, quotes, recurring orders and ledger entries, with prefix and postfix.

sources.ref: DW10 database schema (INFORMATION_SCHEMA of a local DW10 install) and Dynamicweb.Ecommerce 10.29.8

functions.name: Order export to ERP
functions.description: Completed orders are flagged as exported when the ERP integration (batch or live) has picked them up; staff also export order lists to Excel.

notApplicable.when: the demo has no ERP integration

sources.ref: DW10 database schema (INFORMATION_SCHEMA of a local DW10 install) and Dynamicweb.Ecommerce 10.29.8

functions.name: Delivery options per product
functions.description: Which shipping methods (home delivery, pickup) are offered for an article: a shipping method limited to products or product groups (EcomShippings.ShippingProductIds, ShippingProductGroupIds, ShippingProductFilterMode).
